column1: 一路跋涉，你终于来到乱葬荒坟深处，\n没想到坟茔间阴影中，忽有一人暴起发难，抽刀向你袭来，\n竟是一名穷凶极恶的江湖逃犯躲藏在此处。
column2: After a long journey, you finally arrive at the deepest part of the desolate graveyard.\nUnexpectedly, someone leaped out from the shadows among the graves and attacked you with a knife towards you.\nTurns out a vicious and deadly Jianghu fugitive is hiding here.

column2: The rank of the Great Hero is already at the pinnacle that can be reached by those in the Wulin.\nFull moon turns to wane, water overflows its bounds-best not to be too greedy.

column1: 大侠眼力过人，猜中大半，来年若再接再厉，或许就能赢得大奖了。

column2: I am new to your esteemed land, possessing no great skills. Since my youth, I have practiced lightness, allowing me to step on water and follow clouds and moonlight.\nPlease don't miss this! If you have money, please support with money; if you don't, please support with your presence!\nWithout further ado, let me show you a demonstration of wall-running!

column1: 本人初到贵宝地，身无长技，只是自幼练得一金刚不坏，刀枪不入的硬功绝技。\n望您各位走过路过不要错过！有钱捧个钱场，没钱捧个人场！\n废话不多说，给各位表演一个胸口碎大石！

If you have money, please support with money; if you don't, please support with your presence!\nNo need for much talk; let me demonstrate breaking a large stone with my chest!

Locals and travelers stop by for a break or to stay overnight, making for a steady stream of visitors.\nA Young Hero would only need to spend two days and fifty taels of silver, and let me gather the intelligence for you.\nYou can learn about the strange occurrences happening in the surroundings of this place.

column1: 行至一乱石嶙峋之处，只见重峦叠嶂之间，\n赫然蜿蜒着一处富饶矿脉，一眼望去有诸多矿料可供取用。\n但若要从中挑选精品，非得有高超采伐技巧不可。
column2: Arriving at a place where boulders jut out, one sees towering mountains stretching in layers between them.\nThere stretches a fertile mineral vein rich with various minerals, offering a bounty of resources to exploit.\nBut to pick out the finest pieces, one must possess exquisite resource gathering skills.

column1: 行至一山明水秀之处，只见花飞蝶舞之间，\n赫然是一片负气含灵的药田，一眼望去有诸多药材可供取用。\n但若要从中挑选精品，非得有高超木植技巧不可。
column2: Arriving at a place where the mountains are clear and the waters are beautiful, one sees flowers flying and butterflies dancing.\nIt was a field of medicinal herbs infused with spirit, from which many herbs could be harvested at a glance.\nBut to select the finest pieces, one must have exquisite woodworking skills.

column1: 行至一枝繁叶茂之处，只见丛林掩映之间，\n赫然矗立着一株参天巨木，一眼望去有诸多木材可供取用。\n但若要从中挑选精品，非得有高超采伐技巧不可。
column2: Arriving at a place where branches and leaves are lush, I see the jungle hidden between the trees,\nLofty trees stand toweringly, offering plenty of timber at a glance.\nBut to pick out the finest pieces, one must possess exquisite resource gathering skills.

column1: 行至一水草丰茂之处，只见鸟语花香之间，\n赫然是一片生机勃勃的河谷，一眼望去有诸多食材可供取用。\n但若要从中挑选精品，非得有高超木植技巧不可。
column2: Arriving at a place where the grass is lush and verdant, one finds oneself amid the sounds of birds and the fragrance of flowers.\nIt was a vibrant river valley, offering a variety of edible ingredients at first glance.\nBut to select the finest pieces, one must have exquisite woodworking skills.

column1: 行至一穷山恶水之处，只见瘴气缭绕之间，\n赫然是一片泥泞污浊的沼泽，一眼望去有诸多毒物可供捕获。\n但若要从中挑选精品，非得有高超毒术技巧不可。
column2: Travelling to a desolate place among desolate mountains and foul waters, one sees the miasma hanging in the air.\nIt was a muddy and foul swamp, teeming with various poisonous creatures to capture at a glance.\nBut to pick out the best, one must have superb venom techniques.

column1: 这一路走来真是颇为热闹。\n百姓携老扶幼，遍插茱萸，向着城外山上登高而去。
column2: This journey has been quite lively\nFamilies carried the elderly and embraced the young, inserting calamus everywhere and heading to the mountains beyond the city walls for a climb.

column1: 这个月已在此武馆大闹过一场，\n还需低调些时日避避风头，免得引起武林公愤。

column1: 这个月已经举办过门派宴会，还需等待场地打扫整备妥当才是。
column2: This month's sect banquet has already been held, so we need to wait for the venue to be cleaned and prepared before the next one.

column1: 这个月已经大肆宴饮一番，若是天天在这烟花柳巷中流连，只怕为江湖中人耻笑。

column1: 这个月已经宴饮三日，若是天天饮酒作乐，只怕为江湖中人耻笑。
column2: This month has already involved feasting for three days. If we continue to drink and revel every day, we might be laughed at by the people of the Jianghu.

column1: 这个月已经捐出许多银两，\n若是再大肆布施，只怕落得个虚仁假义的名声。
column2: Much silver has been donated this month,\nIf we were to give away more, we might end up with a hollow reputation of being pseudo-benevolent.

column1: 这个月已经潜心闭关过，还需要再积累些实践感悟才是。
column2: This month has already been dedicated to seclusion and cultivation, so I need to accumulate some practical insights first.

column1: 这个月本门已进攻过三次资源点，弟子已然疲敝不堪，\n还需修养整备一番才行。

column2: These treasured items are rarely seen in the world. It is already quite remarkable for a Great Hero to guess half of them. Please accept this prize!

column1: 这伙仇家围攻之下，你被打成重伤。\n情急之下，只能抛弃随身金银细软，然后落荒而逃
column2: Attacked by these enemies, you were severely injured.\nIn a moment of desperation, she could only abandon her personal valuables and flee in panic.

column1: 这似乎是一张......藏宝地图？！\n也不知是谁人留在这儿，若是得空可前去挖掘一番。
column2: This seems to be a... treasure map?!\nI wonder who left this behind. If you have the time, you might want to go and dig it up.

column1: 这位大侠想参加鉴宝猜谜大会？欢迎欢迎！\n只需在众多古董珍宝中猜出价值最贵的那个，便可得分。\n猜中1个，便可获得奖品，若能连续猜中5个，更是有大奖相赠！
column2: This great hero wants to participate in the Antiquity Guessing Festival? Welcome, welcome!\nYou just need to identify the most valuable antique among many to score points.\nGuess 1 correctly to win a prize, and a grand prize is waiting if you can guess 5 in a row!

column1: 这位少侠双手过膝，骨骼精奇，显然正是万中无一的工匠奇才。\n我这儿正好有些冶炼锻造的资源材料，就干脆便宜些卖给你好了！
column2: This young hero's hands extend past his knees, his bones intricate and extraordinary, clearly making him a one-in-a-thousand master craftsman.\nI have some smelting and forging resources here, so I might as well sell them to you at a discount!

column1: 这位少侠行行好啊！我已经饿了几天几夜没吃饭了，\n还望施舍点银两，让叫花子我买口饭吃吧！
column2: This Young Hero, please be kind! I haven't eaten for days and nights, I'm starving.\nI beg you for some silver to buy me a meal, beggar that I am!

column1: 这位施主面色清亮，道骨矍铄，贫道一眼便看出乃是有仙缘之人。\n不知施主可否布施些银两，以作为本观传经说法，炼丹撰符等修仙寻道之用。
column2: This benefactor has a clear and bright complexion, a demeanor indicative of a spiritual disposition. column1: 1. 本游戏是一款武侠题材的开放世界游戏，适用于16周岁及以上的用户，建议未成年人在家长监护下使用游戏产品。\\n\\n2. 本游戏画面为水墨风格，清新淡雅，弘扬我国美学文化。讲述了主角行侠仗义，惩奸除恶，帮助自己的门派发扬光大，造福百姓的故事。游戏中的背景皆为架空，不会与现实混淆。游戏中的玩法多为动脑的策略玩法，没有激烈刺激的战斗画面。游戏内所有内容都遵循相关法律法规。\\n\\n3. 本游戏中有用户实名认证系统，认证为未成年人的用户将接受以下管理：\\n<color=#BC1717>  〇 未满8周岁的用户不能付费购买游戏；8周岁以上的未满16周岁的未成年人用户，不得单次消费超过50元人民币，每月充值消费累计不得超过200元人民币；16周岁以上的未成年人用户，单次消费不得超过100元人民币，每月充值消费累计不得超过400元人民币。\\n  〇 本游戏仅可在周五、周六、周日和法定节假日每日20时至21时向未成年人提供1小时网络游戏服务，其他时间均不以任何形式向未成年人提供网络游戏服务。</color>\\n\\n4. 本游戏以策略玩法为主，玩家可以通过游戏内提供的资源和线索，结合自身长处变得更强，有益于玩家享受游戏乐趣，放松身心。游戏过程中，通过丰富的游戏内容，玩法和剧情等，让玩家身临其境，体会到现实生活中不一样的乐趣。帮助玩家在享受游戏乐趣进行放松与休息后，更好地投入现实中的工作与学习中。\\n
column2: 1. This is a wuxia-themed open-world game suitable for users aged 16 and above. It is recommended that minors play this game with parental guidance.\\n\\n2. The game features a ink-wash style graphics, fresh and elegant, upholding the aesthetic culture of our country. It tells the story of the protagonist practicing chivalry to help the innocent and punish villains, aiming to promote his sect's glory and benefit the people.
